note:
R83 - codec 0x09 identification on every observed family: X360 11-Legacy `ann_eng`, X360 11-14 `pbp_eng`, PS3 14 `pbp_eng`
(32 000 Hz mono, SNS-blocked `.sbs`) and PS4 15-21 `rink_announcer/eng/rink_ann_samples[_inxp].sbr/.sbs` (SBle, .OFF into the .sbs).

Structure measured on NHL data (independent of any reference): each SNS data block's payload is a chain of `u8 length | frame` records
that consumes the block exactly; 6 400-sample blocks hold 10 frames (640 samples = one 20 ms frame at 32 kHz - the Speex ultra-wideband
frame size); the first block declares 6 531 = 11 x 640 - 509 samples and holds 11 frames; the last block declares frames x 640 - tail
trim (0 <= trim < 640); every frame's first bit is 0 (Speex: not an in-band request) and the next 4 bits are a narrowband mode 1..8.
Reference (read, pinned, not vendored): vgmstream revision 4b6a02dd `src/coding/speex_decoder.c` (SHA-256 1c0e0439...) -
EASpeex = u8 size + frame, libspeex UWB mode at 32 000 Hz, encoder delay 509 samples discarded - and `src/meta/ea_eaac.c`
(978c9a37...) codec 0x09 = EASPEEX; vgmstream license: docs COPYING (fcc26d35...), ISC-style. The +131 / -509 first-block rule is a
measurement here; the reference's 509 agrees.
Tests per vector: T1 every block's frame chain consumes it exactly, frame sizes 1..0x100; T2 first block samples + 509 == frames x 640;
T3 middle blocks samples == frames x 640; T4 last block 0 <= frames x 640 - samples < 640 (single-block stream: frames x 640 - 509 - samples in [0, 640)); T5 sum(block samples) == num_samples;
T6 mode census (first 5 bits). Decode (diagnostic): the frames rewrapped as Ogg Speex (UWB header, 32 000 Hz, 1 frame / packet) and
decoded by ffmpeg's `speex` (native) and `libspeex` decoders separately to s16le; expected samples = frames x 640 from both; the two
outputs compared (max abs diff, SHA-256); decoded - 509 - tail_trim == num_samples recorded. Malformed controls per family: last block
truncated by 3 bytes; a frame length byte set to 0; a frame length byte set to 0xff; a block sample word +1 - each must be refused by
the checks above by name. Successful ffmpeg exit is never the criterion; nothing is listened to.
Usage: python r83_codec09_speex.py <out.json> [--trees a,b] [--keep] [--smoke]
